title: Digital Twins as Funhouse Mirrors: Five Key Distortions
benchmark_measurement: The paper measured how the accuracy of LLM-based digital twins varied based on the user's religious attendance habits, as part of a broader analysis on representation bias.
findings: Digital twin accuracy tends to be higher for participants with moderate religious attendance habits, suggesting a representation bias where individuals at the extremes of religious attendance are less accurately represented.
